youtube.description: 退學通知撕掉的那一夜，她抓住小滿書包上的三顆銅鈴。小滿說是奶奶給的，輪椅上的玉琴對她眨了一下眼。鈴一響，她回到民國三十七年那一夜：後院木牆上的火光與濃煙、藥行門框上同一串鈴、一個抱著燈的剪影從門裡走出來。玉琴說，那是媽掛在門上的，她一直替媽收著。隔天上午，林美鳳領著鄭醫師進門，要替玉琴做評估；鄭醫師問今天幾號，她替玉琴答出農曆十月廿二，又從鄭醫師搭脈的手法認出他的老師是當年在沈記抓過藥的梁守正，鄭醫師收了筆。建業說，報告一到就去法院申請監護。深夜她在祠堂添油，門紙上映出輪椅的影子：玉琴自己推到門口，一下一下敲門：「媽，開門。」

data.prompt: Inside the ancestral hall of the old Shen house late at night, seen low from the height of the prayer cushion; in the foreground a lit red candle on the altar, out of focus. Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared cotton shirt and navy ankle-length skirt stands on screen right with her back to the camera and the lamp, facing the lattice doors, the small brass oil pot still in her right hand. The doors are shut and barred with a wooden bolt; on their paper, cast by a paper lamp outside, falls the shadow of a wheelchair: a seated figure and two large wheels. She is the only person inside the hall. The shadow on the paper lifts a hand and knocks twice, then again and again; she turns half a step to look at the doors, the oil pot stopping at her chest. Mouth closed; the voice comes from outside the door.

lines.speaker: yuetang-18
lines.text: 開了這扇門，她明天就更說不清了。

data.prompt: Inside the ancestral hall of the old Shen house late at night: Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared cotton shirt; behind her the brass oil lamp, the plain blank ancestral tablets out of focus and two red candles; the lamplight from behind outlines her head and shoulders. She is the only person in the frame, not smiling, her eyes red. She slowly sets the oil pot back on the altar, draws her hands back and folds them at her waist, her knuckles tightening; another round of knocking comes from the doors; she does not move toward them and stands frozen in front of the lamp. Her mouth stays closed; the line is her inner voice.
